title: Sparse extreme-burst spread-down supplement: all-25 development evaluation
disclosure: Rule shape and parameters (z>20, >=4 extreme tests, first scan at 72, alpha 0.10) were proposed after W15/W25 were examined; W6/W12/W15/W21/W24 and all anomaly wafers were inspected during development. Normal-only fitting of baselines and floors does not remove that selection bias. This is a development candidate, not independent validation.
